flow: Generate -> Evaluate -> add/remove attachment -> Revise -> Change Difficulty -> Confirm/Evaluate/Save (browser)
purpose: Repeat the complete Alice Smith policy-review walkthrough with fixed campaign context.

generation_context.organization_context: Windropolis employees review updated internal policies in the Windropolis portal. Alice Smith works in IT Support and is a familiar colleague to this audience.
generation_context.additional_instructions: Write a short policy update email with a normal review link. Use {{.URL}} for the link.

evaluation_context.situation_context: The company is conducting a scheduled routine review of its updated internal policy this week; employees expect review messages.

manual_revision_feedback: Shorten the note, keep the policy-review scenario and the GoPhish {{.URL}} link, and do not invent a deadline or consequences.

change_difficulty.feedback: Preserve Alice Smith and the routine policy-review context; change only the email content.
